description: This file defines a React component for a synchronization configuration modal, including UI elements for selecting sync providers, proxy settings, and credentials, as well as a check button to verify connection status.

methods.name: CheckButton
methods.description: A React component that renders a button to check the cloud sync connection status, displaying different icons based on the current check state.

methods.name: SyncConfigModal
methods.description: A React component that renders a modal dialog for configuring sync options such as provider, proxy, and credentials, with actions to check connection and confirm settings.
